senses.gloss:
प्रत्य्-अय, अस्, m. belief, firm conviction, trust,
faith, reliance, assurance, confidence (प्रत्ययं
गम्, to acquire confidence, repose confidence in;
अस्त्य् अत्र प्रत्ययो मम, that is my conviction;
कः प्रत्ययो ऽत्र, what assurance is there of
that?); certainty, ascertainment; knowledge, expe-
rience; apprehension, understanding, intellect (in the
Sāṅkhya phil. = बुद्धि); acceptation, idea, notion,
[]
conception; ground, motive; (with Buddhists) a co-
operating cause, the concurrent occasion of an event as
distinguished from its proximate cause; an instrument,
means of agency; an assistant, associate; celebrity,
fame; analysis (?); definition (?); (in Ved. gram.) a
subsequent or following letter; (according to native lexi-
cographers) an oath, ordeal; a dependent, a subject;
usage, custom, practice; religious contemplation; a
householder who keeps a sacred fire; a hole.
—प्र-
त्यय-कारक, अस्, इका, अम्, producing assurance,
awakening confidence.
—प्रत्यय-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ,
causing confidence; (इणी), f. ‘producing assurance,’
a seal, signet.
—प्रत्यय-त्व, अम्, n. the being a
cause, causality.
—प्रत्यय-सर्ग, अस्, m. (in the
Sāṅkhya phil.) the intellectual creation.
प्रत्यय प्रत्य्-अय, &c. See प्रती, p. 623.

प्रत्य्-अय, अस्, m.; add — a grammatical affix or
any suffix to roots forming derivatives.
प्रत्य्-आय, अस्, m. revenue, tax, toll, tribute.

प्रत्याय प्रत्य्-आय, अस्, m. (fr. प्रती, q. v.),
‘what comes in as revenue,’ toll, tax, tribute.

प्रत्याया प्रत्य्-आ-या, cl. 2. P. -याति, -यातुम्,
to go towards (with acc.).

प्रत्य्-अयन, see Gaṇa Gotrādi to Pāṇ. VIII. 1,
27, 57.

2. प्रत्य्-आयन, अम्, n. (for 2. see under प्रत्य्-ए),
leading home (a wife), marrying (?); (अम्, आ), n. f.
producing assurance, proving, demonstrating, making
clear or intelligible, analyzing, explaining, expounding.

1. प्रत्य्-आयन, अम्, n. leading home (a wife),
marrying; setting (of the sun); (अम्, आ), n. f. making
intelligible, analysing, explaining, explanation; prov-
ing, &c. See under प्रती.
प्रत्यायन 2. प्रत्य्-आयन. See प्रत्य्-ए, p. 629.

2. प्रत्य्-आयन, अम्, n. (for 1. see under प्रती,
p. 623), setting (of the sun).

प्रत्ययिक, अस्, आ, अम्, (at the end of a comp.)
resting or depending upon.

प्रात्ययिक प्रात्ययिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रत्य्-
अय), relating to or attended with confidence or trust,
confidential, trusty, having faith in; (अस्), m., scil. प्रति-
भू, a surety for the trustworthiness of a debtor.

प्रत्य्-अयित, अस्, आ, अम्, confided in, relied upon,
trusted, trusty, confidential.

प्रत्य्-आयित, अस्, m. a confidential agent, com-
missioned servant, commissioner.

प्रत्य्-आयित, अस्, m., Ved. a confidential agent,
&c. See under प्रती.

प्रत्ययिन्, ई, इनी, इ, deserving trust or confi-
dence, trustworthy; having faith in, trusting, be-
lieving, relying upon.

प्रत्य्-आयक, अस्, इका, अम्, producing assurance,
proving, making intelligible or clear, explaining,
elucidating.

प्रत्य्-आयक, अस्, इका, अम्, making intelligible,
explaining, making clear, &c. See under प्रती.

प्रत्य्-आयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be proved, to be
made clear or intelligible.

प्रत्य्-आयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made clear, to
be proved.

प्रत्य्-एतव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be acknowledged or
admitted; to be relied on or believed.

प्रत्य्-एतव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be admitted or ac-
knowledged.

प्रत्येतव्य प्रत्य्-एतव्य. See under प्रत्य्-
आय, p. 627, col. 2.

प्रत्य्-एतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, believing, trusting, having
confidence, a believer.

प्रत्यंशु प्रत्य्-अंशु, उस्, m., see Scholiast to
Pāṇ. VI. 2, 193.

प्रत्यक् प्रत्यक्. See under प्रत्य्-अञ्च्, p. 625,
col. 1.

प्रत्यक्ष प्रत्य्-अक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, perceptible
to the eye, being present before the eyes, in sight,
perceptible, sensible, cognizable by any of the organs
of sense (opposed to परोऽक्ष, q. v.); clear, dis-
tinct, evident, undoubted, express, explicit, actual,
real; corporeal; immediate; having before the eyes,
keeping in view, discerning; (अम्), n. perceptibility,
ocular evidence, clearness, distinctness, explicitness;
superintendence; (in philosophy) apprehension by the
senses, sensation, perception, intuition; (in rhetoric)
a kind of style descriptive of impressions derived from
the senses; (अम्, आत्, एण), ind. before the eyes, in
the sight of; with direct personal knowledge, dis-
tinctly, clearly; in the face of, in the presence of,
before; publicly; immediately, directly, explicitly,
really; literally; personally; at first sight, at sight;
(ए), ind. in the sight of, before the eyes of.
—प्रत्य्-
अक्ष-कृता, f., Ved., scil. ऋक्, a hymn or verse in
which a deity is addressed directly or in the second
person (e. g. O Indra, thou &c.).
—प्रत्यक्ष-
खण्ड, अस्, अम्, m. n., N. of the first part of the
Tattva-cintā-maṇi a Nyāya work by Gaṅgeśa.
—प्र-
त्यक्ष-ज्ञान, अम्, n. knowledge obtained by per-
[]
ception.
—प्रत्यक्ष-तमाम् or प्रत्यक्ष-त-
मात्, ind., Ved. most perceptibly; most directly; most
evidently.
—प्रत्यक्ष-तस्, ind. before the eyes,
in presence of, visibly, perceptibly, (प्रत्यक्षतः
श्रुतम्, heard perceptibly or with the ears); evi-
dently, clearly, plainly.
—प्रत्यक्ष-ता, f. or प्र-
त्यक्ष-त्व, अम्, n. visibility, perceptibility, per-
ception by the senses, ocular demonstration; the
standing face to face; explicitness; addressing in
the second person (Ved.); प्रत्यक्षतया, visibly.
—प्रत्यक्ष-दर्शन, अम्, n. seeing with one's
own eyes, witnessing or seeing in person; the power
of discerning the godhead present (in the sacrifice);
(अस्), m. an eye-witness, witness.
—प्रत्यक्ष-
दर्शिन्, ई, इनी, इ, seeing with one's own eyes, one who
has seen with his own eyes, an eye-witness.
—प्रत्य्-
अक्ष-दर्शिवस्, आन्, m. one who has seen anything
with his own eyes, an eye-witness; seeing anything
clearly as if before the eyes.
—प्रत्यक्ष-दृश्, क्,
क्, क्, seeing distinctly, one who sees anything clearly
as if before the eyes.
—प्रत्यक्ष-दृश्य, अस्,
आ, अम्, to be seen with the eyes, visible, per-
ceptible.
—प्रत्यक्ष-दृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, seen
with the eyes.
—प्रत्यक्ष-परीक्षण, अम्, n.
real observation or examination.
—प्रत्यक्ष-
प्रमा, f. correct or certain knowledge obtained
through the senses.
—प्रत्यक्ष-प्रमाण, अम्, n.
ocular or visible proof, the evidence of the senses;
an organ or faculty of perception.
—प्रत्यक्ष-
फल, अम्, n. a visible consequence.
—प्रत्यक्ष-
बृहती, f., Ved. a real or original Bṛhatī, an
evident Bṛhatī.
—प्रत्यक्ष-भक्ष, अस्, m.,
Ved. real or actual eating.
—प्रत्यक्ष-भूत, अस्,
आ, अम्, become visible, manifested.
—प्रत्यक्ष-
भोग, अस्, m. enjoyment or use of anything in the
presence of or with the knowledge of the owner.
—प्रत्यक्ष-वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, ‘asserting percep-
tion by the senses,’ one who admits of no other
evidence than perception by the senses; (ई), m. a
Buddhist.
—प्रत्यक्ष-विहित, अस्, आ, अम्, expressly
enjoined.
—प्रत्यक्ष-वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, having a
form which is visible to the eye; composed clearly
or intelligibly.
—प्रत्यक्ष-सिद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्,
determined by the evidence of the senses.
—प्रत्य्-
अक्षी-करण, अम्, n. looking at, viewing; making
manifest or apparent.
—प्रत्यक्षी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A.
-करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to make visible or evident;
to inspect, look at with one's own eyes, see.
—प्रत्य्-
अक्षी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, seen with the eyes; made
present or visible; manifested, displayed.

प्रात्यक्ष प्रात्यक्ष or प्रात्यक्षिक, अस्, ई, अम्,
perceptible to the eyes, &c. (= प्रत्यक्ष, q. v.).

प्रत्यक्षय, Nom. P. प्रत्यक्षयति, -यितुम्,
to make visible or perceptible, manifest, display.

प्रत्यक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, seeing or perceiving with
one's own eyes, perceiving by the senses, witnessing
in person; (ई), m. an eye-witness.

प्रत्यक्षरम् प्रत्य्-अक्षरम्, ind. at each syl-
lable, syllable by syllable, letter by letter, literally.

प्रत्यग्नि प्रत्य्-अग्नि, ind. towards the fire;
at or near or in every fire.

प्रत्यग्र प्रत्य्-अग्र, अस्, आ, अम्, fresh, recent,
new, young; repeated, reiterated; pure (अस्),
m., N. of a son of Vasu Upari-cara and prince
of the Cedis.
—प्रत्यग्र-क्षरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्,
fresh-flowing, flowing freshly.
—प्रत्यग्र-गन्धा,
f. a species of shrub, Rhinacanthus Communis.
—प्रत्यग्र-ता, f. or प्रत्यग्र-त्व, अम्, n. new-
ness, freshness.
—प्रत्यग्र-प्रसवा, f. recently
delivered, having lately brought forth.
—प्रत्यग्र-
वयस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, young in age, youthful, young;
(अस्), n. youth.
—प्रत्यग्र-शोधित, अस्, आ, अम्,
recently purified, pure.

प्रत्यङ्क प्रत्य्-अङ्क, अस्, आ, अम्, recently
marked.

प्रत्यङ्ग प्रत्य्-अङ्ग, अम्, n. a minor or se-
condary member of the body (as the forehead, nose,
[]
chin, fingers, ears, &c.; the six aṅgas or chief mem-
bers being the trunk, head, arms, and legs); a
division, section, part, subdivision (of a science &c.);
a weapon; (अस्), m., N. of a prince; (अम्), ind. on
every part or member of the body, on every limb,
on the limbs severally; for every part or subdivision
(of a sacrifice &c.); in each base (in grammar).
—प्रत्यङ्ग-दक्षिणा, f. a fee for each part (of
a sacrifice).

प्रत्यङ्गिरस् प्रत्य्-अङ्गिरस्, आस्, m., N. of a
mythical personage (who like Aṅgiras married a
number of the daughters of Dakṣa).

प्रत्य्-अङ्गिरस, अस्, m., N. of a mythical per-
sonage regarded as the father of certain Ṛcas.

प्रत्य्-अङ्गिरा, f. a form of Durgā, one of the
goddesses of the Tāntrikas.

प्रत्यजिर प्रत्य्-अजिर, अम्, n., see Gaṇa
Aṃśv-ādi to Pāṇ. VI. 2, 193.

प्रत्यञ्च् प्रत्य्-अञ्च्, प्रत्यङ्, प्रतीची (accord-
ing to Vopa-deva IV. 12. also प्रत्यञ्ची), प्रत्यक्
(fr. rt. 1. अञ्च् with प्रति), turned towards, directed
towards, proceeding to (with acc.); being behind,
coming from behind; subsequent, following (in time
or place); turning the back upon, turning back,
turning away, turned away, averted, taking an oppo-
site direction; western, occidental, westerly, west,
turned or directed towards the west, to the west of
(with abl.); turned inwards, inner, interior; equal
to, a match for; uniform, unmixed (?); (प्रतीची),
f. (with or without दिश्), the western quarter, the
west; (प्रत्यक्), ind. backwards, back, in an opposite
direction; behind; against; to the west, westwards,
to the west of (with abl.); in the interior, inwardly;
in former times.
—प्रतीचीश, अस्, m. ‘lord of the
west,’ an epithet of Varuṇa.
—प्रत्यक्-चेतन, अस्,
आ, अम्, one whose thoughts are turned inwards or
upon himself; rightly intelligent.
—प्रत्यक्-तत्त्व-
दीपिका, f., N. of a work confuting the Nyāya philo-
sophy upon the basis of the Vedānta.
—प्रत्यक्-
तत्त्व-विवेक, अस्, m., N. of a philosophical work.
—प्रत्यक्-त्व, अम्, n. backward direction, direc-
tion towards one's self.
—प्रत्यक्-पर्णी, f. a species
of plant, Achyranthes Aspera (= अपामार्ग); the
plant Anthericum Tuberosum (= द्रवन्ती).
—प्र-
त्यक्-पुष्पी, f. a species of plant, Achyranthes
Aspera; (according to Vārttika I. to Pāṇ. IV. 1, 64.
the correct form would be प्रत्यक्-पुष्पा.)
—प्र-
त्यक्-शिरस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, having the head turned
towards the west.
—प्रत्यक्-श्रेणी, f., N. of various
plants, Anthericum Tuberosum; Croton Polyandrum
or Croton Tiglium; Salvinia Cucullata (commonly
called इन्दुरकानी दन्ती).
—प्रत्यक्-स्रोतस्, आस्,
आस्, अस्, flowing towards the west; (often wrongly
spelt प्रत्यक्-श्रोतस्.)
—प्रत्यग्-अक्ष, अम्, n.
an inner organ, internal faculty; (अस्, आ, अम्), having
inner organs.
—प्रत्यगक्ष-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, dis-
cerned by the internal faculties, visible to the eye
of the soul.
—प्रत्यग्-आत्म-त्व, अम्, n. universal
permeation of spirit.
—प्रत्यग्-आत्मन्, आ, m. the
individual soul.
—प्रत्यग्-आनन्द, अस्, आ, अम्,
inwardly rejoicing, internally joyful.
—प्रत्यग्-आशा-
पति, इस्, m. ‘lord of the western quarter,’ an epithet
of Varuṇa.
—प्रत्यग्-उदक्, ind. towards the north-
west.
—प्रत्यग्-दक्षिणतस्, ind. towards the
south-west.
—प्रत्यग्-दक्षिणा, ind., Ved. towards
the south-west.
—प्रत्यग्-दृश्, क्, f. an inward
glance, glance directed inwards.
—प्रत्यग्-धामन्,
आ, आ, अ, radiant within, internally illuminated.
—प्र-
त्यग्-रथ, आस्, m. pl., N. of a warrior-tribe (also
called अहि-च्छत्त्र; cf. प्रात्यग्रथि).
—प्रत्यङ्-
मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, having the face turned away,
having the face averted, facing the west.
प्रत्य्-अञ्चित, अस्, आ, अम्, honoured.

प्रत्यञ्ज् प्रत्य्-अञ्ज्, cl. 7. P. -अनक्ति, -अञ्जितुम्,
अङ्क्तुम्, Ved. to smear over, besmear; to decorate.

प्रत्य्-अञ्जन, अम्, n. smearing over, smearing,
anointing.

प्रत्यदन प्रत्य्-अदन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. अद्),
eating; food.

प्रत्य्-आदान, अम्, n. taking back anything given,
receiving back, resumption, reobtaining; repeating,
repetition (Ved.).

प्रत्यधी प्रत्य्-अधी (प्रति-अधि-इ), cl. 2. P.
-अध्य्-एति, -एतुम्, to read through or study severally.

प्रत्यनन्तर प्रत्य्-अनन्तर, अस्, आ, अम्, being
in the immediate neighbourhood (of a person or
thing), closely connected with, immediately follow-
ing; standing nearest (as an heir); (अम्), ind.
immediately after (with abl.); next in succession.

प्रत्यनिलम् प्रत्य्-अनिलम्, ind. against the
wind.

प्रत्यनीक प्रत्य्-अनीक, अस्, आ, अम्, hostile,
opposed, opposite; withstanding, resisting; (अस्),
m. an enemy; (अम्), n. a hostile army; hostility,
enmity, a hostile relation, hostile position; injuring
the relatives of an enemy who cannot be injured
himself; injuring one who cannot retaliate (?).
—प्र-
त्यनीक-त्व, अम्, n. the state of an enemy, hostility.

प्रत्यनुज्ञा प्रत्य्-अनु-ज्ञा, cl. 9. P. A. -जानाति,
जानीते, -ज्ञातुम्, to disallow, refuse, reject; to spurn.

प्रत्यनुतप् प्रत्य्-अनु-तप्, Pass. -तप्यते,
&c., to feel subsequent remorse, repent, regret.

प्रत्यनुनी प्रत्य्-अनु-नी, cl. 1. P. A. -नयति,
-ते, -नेतुम्, to bring to submission, induce to yield;
to declare against, protest against; to disagree; to
deny.

प्रत्यनुभू प्रत्य्-अनु-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति,
-भवितुम्, to enjoy singly or severally.

प्रत्यनुमान प्रत्य्-अनुमान, अम्, n. a con-
trary deduction, opposite conclusion.

प्रत्यन्त प्रत्य्-अन्त, अस्, आ, अम्, bordering on,
bordering, adjacent or contiguous to, skirting; (अस्),
m. a border, frontier; a bordering country, i. e. a
country occupied by barbarians, the country of the
Mlecchas or savages; (आस्), m. pl. barbarous tribes;
(आत्), ind., Ved. to the end.
—प्रत्यन्त-देश, अस्, m.
a neighbouring country, a country bordering upon
another.
—प्रत्यन्त-पर्वत, अस्, m. an adjacent
hill, a small hill near a mountain.

प्रत्यपकार प्रत्य्-अपकार, अस्, m. offending
or injuring in return, retaliation.

प्रत्यब्दम् प्रत्य्-अब्दम्, ind. every year,
year by year, yearly.

प्रत्यभिघृ प्रत्य्-अभि-घृ, Caus. P. -घार-
यति, -यितुम्, Ved. to sprinkle over repeatedly.

प्रत्य्-अभिघारण, अम्, n., Ved. sprinkling
over afresh.

प्रत्यभिचर् प्रत्य्-अभि-चर्, cl. 1. P. -चरति,
-चरितुम्, Ved. to use spells or charms against,
employ incantations against.

प्रत्य्-अभिचरण, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. using spells
or charms against, employing incantations against.

प्रत्यभिज्ञा 1. प्रत्य्-अभि-ज्ञा, cl. 9. P. A.
-जानाति, -जानीते, -ज्ञातुम्, to recognise again; to
come to one's self, recover one's consciousness.

2. प्रत्य्-अभिज्ञा, f. recognising again, recogni-
tion; N. of a philosophical work.

प्रत्य्-अभिज्ञात, अस्, आ, अम्, recognised again,
recognised, known.

प्रत्य्-अभिज्ञान, अम्, n. recognising again, re-
cognising, recognition, knowing; a token of recog-
nition (which a messenger brings back to prove that
he has duly accomplished his mission).
—प्रत्यभि-
ज्ञान-रत्न, अम्, n. jewel of recognition, a jewel
given as a token of recognition.

प्रत्य्-अभिज्ञाय, ind. having recognised again,
having recognised.

प्रत्यभिधा प्रत्य्-अभि-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -द-
धाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to place back, bring or
draw back, reabsorb; to reply, answer; to give con-
sent.

प्रत्यभिधाव् प्रत्य्-अभि-धाव्, cl. 1. P. -धा-
वति, -धावितुम्, to run or hasten towards.

प्रत्यभिनन्द् प्रत्य्-अभि-नन्द्, cl. 1. P. -नन्-
दति, -नन्दितुम्, to greet or salute in return, return
a salutation; to bid welcome.

प्रत्य्-अभिनन्दिन्, ई, इनी, इ, receiving or accept-
ing with thanks.

प्रत्यभिप्रस्था प्रत्य्-अभि-प्र-स्था, cl. 1. A.
-तिष्ठते, -स्थातुम्, to set out towards, set out for,
depart; to march towards.

प्रत्यभिभाषिन् प्रत्य्-अभिभाषिन्, ई, इणी, इ,
speaking to, addressing.

प्रत्यभिभूत प्रत्य्-अभिभूत, अस्, आ, अम्, over-
powered, overcome, conquered.

प्रत्यभिमिथ् प्रत्य्-अभि-मिथ्, cl. 1. 6. P.
-मेथति, -मिथति, &c., Ved. to answer scornfully
or abusively.
प्रत्य्-अभिमेथन, अम्, n., Ved. a scornful reply.

प्रत्यभिमृश् प्रत्य्-अभि-मृश्, cl. 6. P. -मृ-
शति, -मर्ष्टुम्, -म्रष्टुम्, to stroke over, stroke
down, touch; to lay hold of.

प्रत्य्-अभिमर्श, अस्, m. or प्रत्य्-अभिमर्-
शन, अम्, n., Ved. rubbing, touching (with the
hand).

प्रत्यभियुक्त प्रत्य्-अभियुक्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr.
rt. युज् with प्रत्य्-अभि), accused in return, charged
by a counter plaint.

प्रत्य्-अभियोग, अस्, m. a counter plaint or charge,
a counter accusation, an accusation brought against
the accuser or plaintiff, recrimination.

प्रत्यभिवद् प्रत्य्-अभि-वद्, Caus. A. -वाद-
यते, -यितुम्, to return a salute, greet in return.

प्रत्य्-अभिवाद, अस्, m. returning a salutation or
greeting; acknowledging a benediction.

प्रत्य्-अभिवादक, अस्, इका, अम्, returning a
salutation or greeting.

प्रत्य्-अभिवादन, अम्, n. returning a salutation
or greeting (Manu II. 126).

प्रत्य्-अभिवादयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who re-
turns a salutation or greeting.

प्रत्यभिस्कन्दन प्रत्य्-अभिस्कन्दन, अम्, n. a
counter plaint or charge, an accusation brought against
the accuser or plaintiff; [cf. प्रत्य्-अभियोग.]

प्रत्यभ्यनुज्ञा 1. प्रत्य्-अभ्य्-अनु-ज्ञा, cl. 9. P.
A. -जानाति, -जानीते, -ज्ञातुम्, to dismiss any one
when taking leave.
2. प्रत्य्-अभ्यनुज्ञा, f., Ved. leave, permission.

प्रत्य्-अभ्यनुज्ञात, अस्, आ, अम्, dismissed on
taking leave, allowed to depart.

प्रत्यमित्र प्रत्य्-अमित्र, अस्, आ, अम्, opposed
as an enemy, hostile; (अस्), m. an enemy, oppo-
nent, adversary.

प्रत्ययनस्त्व प्रत्ययनस्त्व, अम्, n., Ved.
obtaining again, reobtaining, recovery.

प्रत्यरा प्रत्य्-अरा, f., Ved. an intermediate
spoke of a wheel.

प्रत्यरि प्रत्य्-अरि, इस्, m. a well-matched
opponent, equally powerful enemy.

प्रत्यर्क प्रत्य्-अर्क, अस्, m. a mock sun,
parhelion.

प्रत्यर्च् प्रत्य्-अर्च्, cl. 1. P. -अर्चति, -अर्चितुम्,
to shine towards, shine upon (Ved.): Caus. -अर्च-
यति, -यितुम्, to return a salutation (with acc.); to
salute one by one.

प्रत्य्-अर्चन, अम्, n. returning a salutation or
obeisance.

प्रत्यर्थ् प्रत्य्-अर्थ्, cl. 10. P. -अर्थयति,
-यितुम्, to seek (any one) as an opponent, challenge
(to combat).

प्रत्य्-अर्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, useful, expedient; (अम्),
n. a reply, answer, counter representation; opposi-
tion, hostility; (अम्), ind. at every object, in every
case.
प्रत्यर्थक, अस्, m. an opponent, adversary.

प्रत्यर्थिक, अस्, आ, अम्, = प्रत्य्-अर्थिन्, an
opponent (at the end of a comp.; cf. बहु-प्˚).

प्रत्य्-अर्थिन्, ई, इनी, इ, hostile, inimical; opposing,
contradicting, rejecting; emulating; (ई), m. an
enemy, opponent, adversary, rival; (in law) a de-
fendant.
—प्रत्यर्थि-ता, f. or प्रत्यर्थि-त्व,
अम्, n. the state of a defendant at law.
—प्रत्य्-
अर्थ्य्-आवेदन, अम्, n. (in a lawsuit) the verbal
information or deposition of the defendant which
is written down by the officers of the court.

प्रत्यर्द् प्रत्य्-अर्द्, Caus. P. A. -अर्दयति,
-ते, -यितुम्, to oppress or press hard in return,
assault in return, return an attack.

प्रत्यर्पण प्रत्य्-अर्पण, प्रत्य्-अर्पणीय. See
under प्रत्य्-ऋ, p. 629, col. 1.

प्रत्य्-अर्पण, अम्, n. giving back, restoring,
delivering back, returning.

प्रत्यर्ष प्रत्य्-अर्ष, अस्, m. (rt. ऋष्), Ved.
(perhaps) the slope or side (of a hill).
प्रत्यर्हम् प्रत्य्-अर्हम् in यथा-प्˚, q. v.

प्रत्यवकर्शन प्रत्य्-अवकर्शन, अस्, ई, अम्
(fr. rt. कृश् with प्रत्य्-अव), bringing down or
reducing to insignificance, baffling, annihilating.

प्रत्यवगम् प्रत्य्-अव-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्-
छति, -गन्तुम्, to know one by one, recognise
severally.

प्रत्यवग्रह् प्रत्य्-अव-ग्रह्, cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्-
णाति, -गृह्णीते, -ग्रहीतुम्, to draw back, withdraw,
resume, retract, revoke, recall.

प्रत्यवधा प्रत्य्-अव-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -द-
धाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, Ved. to apply again.

प्रत्यवनेजन प्रत्य्-अवनेजन, अम्, n., Ved.
washing off again.

प्रत्यवभुज् प्रत्य्-अव-भुज् (see rt. 1. भुज्),
cl. 6. P. -भुजति, -भोक्तुम्, to bend back.

प्रत्यवमर्श प्रत्य्-अवमर्श, अस्, m. inner
contemplation, profound meditation; counsel, advice,
injunction; a counter conclusion; recollection [cf.
स्मृति-प्˚]; (sometimes less correctly spelt प्रत्य्-
[]
अवमर्ष.)
—प्रत्यवमर्श-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
absorbed in thought or reflection, meditative.

प्रत्य्-अवमर्शन, अम्, n. contemplation, re-
flection, pondering (according to a Scholiast = युक्-
तायुक्त-विचार).

प्रत्यवमृष् प्रत्य्-अव-मृष्, cl. 4. 1. P. A.
-मृष्यति, -ते, -मर्षति, -ते, -मर्षितुम्, to
endure reluctantly, suffer beyond endurance.

प्रत्यवयवम् प्रत्य्-अवयवम्, ind. in every
part or particular, in detail.
—प्रत्यवयव-वर्-
णन, अम्, आ, n. f. a detailed or minute description,
description of every part.

प्रत्यवर प्रत्य्-अवर, अस्, आ, अम्, lower, more
insignificant, less honoured.

प्रत्यवरुह् प्रत्य्-अव-रुह्, Caus. P. -रोप-
यति, -यितुम्, to cause to descend from, bring down
from; to deprive of (with abl.).
प्रत्य्-अवरूढि, इस्, f., Ved. descending towards.

प्रत्य्-अवरोपित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to descend
from; deprived, bereft of.

प्रत्य्-अवरोह, अस्, m., Ved. descending towards;
a descending series.

प्रत्य्-अवरोहण, अम्, n., Ved. descending
towards; N. of a particular Gṛhya festival in the
month Mārgaśīrṣa.

प्रत्य्-अवरोहणीय, अस्, m., Ved. a particular
Ekāha sacrifice forming part of the Vājapeya.

प्रत्य्-अवरोहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. descending, mov-
ing downwards; moving or rising from a seat.

प्रत्यवरोधन प्रत्य्-अवरोधन, अम्, n. ob-
struction, interruption.

प्रत्यवसान प्रत्य्-अवसान, अम्, n. (fr. rt. सो
with प्रत्य्-अव), consuming, consumption, eating.
प्रत्य्-अवसित, अस्, आ, अम्, consumed, eaten.

प्रत्यवस्कन्द प्रत्य्-अवस्कन्द, अस्, m. or प्र-
त्य्-अवस्कन्दन, अम्, n. a special plea at law,
admitting a fact but qualifying or explaining it so
as not to allow it to be matter of accusation.

प्रत्यवस्था 1. प्रत्य्-अव-स्था, cl. 1. P. A.
-तिष्ठति, -ते, -स्थातुम्, to stand alone or sepa-
rately; to attain to again, reattain, recover: Caus.
-स्थापयति, -यितुम्, to cause to stand firm; (with
आत्मानम्) to collect one's self, recover.
2. प्रत्य्-अवस्था, f. = पर्य्-अवस्था, q. v.

प्रत्य्-अवस्थातृ, ता, m. an opponent, adversary,
enemy.

प्रत्य्-अवस्थान, अम्, n. removal, setting aside;
former state or place, status quo; opposition, hostility.
प्रत्य्-अवस्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, standing separately.

प्रत्यवहृ प्रत्य्-अव-हृ, Caus. P. -हारयति,
-यितुम्, to cause to take away; to suspend, interrupt.

प्रत्य्-अवहार, अस्, m. drawing back, withdraw-
ing, withdrawal; dissolution, reabsorption.

प्रत्यवाप् प्रत्य्-अवाप् (प्रति-अव-आप्), cl. 5. P.
-आप्नोति, -आप्तुम्, to obtain back, reobtain, recover.

प्रत्यवे प्रत्य्-अवे (प्रति-अव-इ), cl. 2. P.
-अवैति, -अवैतुम्, Ved. to go down towards, reach
in going downwards.

प्रत्य्-अवाय, अस्, m. decrease, diminution, pri-
vation, detriment, harm; reverse, opposite course,
contrary course or proceeding, contrariety, opposition
(Manu IV. 245); annoyance, disagreeableness; dis-
appointment, disarrangement; offence, sin, sinfulness;
disappearance of anything that exists; non-production
of what does not exist.

प्रत्यवेक्ष् प्रत्य्-अवेक्ष् (प्रति-अव-ईक्ष्), cl.
1. A. -अवेक्षते, -अवेक्षितुम्, to look towards,
look at; to view, inspect, look after; to regard,
have regard for.

प्रत्य्-अवेक्षण, अम्, n. or प्रत्य्-अवेक्षा, f.
looking at, looking after, taking care of, care about.

प्रत्य्-अवेक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be looked at, to
be regarded or considered, to be taken care of.
प्रत्यश्मन् प्रत्य्-अश्मन्, आ, m. red chalk.

प्रत्यष्ठीला प्रत्य्-अष्ठीला, f. a kind of
nervous disease.

प्रत्यस् 1. प्रत्य्-अस् (see rt. 1. अस्), cl. 2. P.
-अस्ति, Ved. to be equal to, to be a match for; to
rival, emulate, vie with; (according to Sāy. = प्रति-
निधिर् अस्.)

प्रत्यस् 2. प्रत्य्-अस् (see rt. 2. अस्), cl. 4. P.
-अस्यति, -असितुम्, to throw towards, throw down; to
turn over, turn round; to throw off, put away, let go.

प्रत्यास् प्रत्य्-आस्, cl. 2. A. -आस्ते, -आसितुम्,
Ved. to sit down opposite to or in the direction of
(with acc.).
प्रत्य्-अस्त्र, अम्, n. a missile hurled in return.

प्रत्यस्तगमन प्रत्य्-अस्तगमन, अम्, n., Ved.
the setting (of the sun).

प्रत्य्-अस्तमय, अस्, m. the setting (of the sun);
cessation, end, destruction.

प्रत्यह् प्रत्य्-अह्, a defective verb only used
in the Perf. -आह, to say anything in the presence of
(with acc.); to relate anything (acc.) to any one
(acc.); to reply, answer.

प्रत्यहम् प्रत्य्-अहम्, ind. day by day, every
day, daily; in the morning.

प्रत्याकल् प्रत्य्-आ-कल्, cl. 10. P. -कलयति,
-यितुम्, to enumerate; to reproach, accuse, con-
demn (?).

प्रत्य्-आकलित, अस्, आ, अम्, enumerated; inter-
posed; introduced (as a step in legal process).

प्रत्याकाङ्क्ष् प्रत्य्-आ-काङ्क्ष्, cl. 1. P. A.
-काङ्क्षति, -ते, -काङ्क्षितुम्, to be eagerly de-
sirous of, long for, expect, wait for, watch for.

प्रत्याकार प्रत्य्-आकार, अस्, m. a scabbard,
sword-sheath.

प्रत्याक्रुश् प्रत्य्-आ-क्रुश्, cl. 1. P. -क्रोशति,
-क्रोष्टुम्, to shout in return; to revile or execrate
in turn, revile again.

प्रत्याक्षेपक प्रत्य्-आक्षेपक, अस्, इका, अम्,
reviling in turn, reviling, jeering, deriding, derisive,
treating scornfully.
—प्रत्याक्षेप-त्व, अम्, n. de-
risiveness, abusiveness.

प्रत्याख्या प्रत्य्-आ-ख्या, cl. 2. P. -ख्याति,
-ख्यातुम्, to proclaim one by one (Ved.); to de-
cline, refuse, reject, disallow; to deny; to interdict; to
excel, surpass, outvie; to counteract (by remedies).

प्रत्य्-आख्यात, अस्, आ, अम्, informed, apprised;
denied, disallowed, refused; discouraged, prohibited,
forbidden; removed, set aside; celebrated, notorious.
—प्रत्याख्यात-त्व, अम्, n. the being rejected or
refused; rejection.

प्रत्य्-आख्यातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who refuses or
denies, a refuser, denier.

प्रत्य्-आख्यान, अम्, n. refusal, denial, disallow-
ance; rejection, repulse; refutation; not admitting,
not accepting as true; disregard; reproach; N. of
one of the fourteen Pūrvas or most ancient writings
of the Jainas.

प्रत्य्-आख्यायम्, ind., Ved. having refuted or
rejected, having denied.

प्रत्य्-आख्यायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. rejecting, refuting
(in अ-प्˚).

प्रत्य्-आख्येय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be declined or
refused; to be rejected or repulsed; to be refuted or
denied; not to be cured, incurable.
—प्रत्याख्येय-
ता, f. the being rejected; incurableness.

प्रत्यागम् प्रत्य्-आ-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति,
-गन्तुम्, to come back, come again, return; to
come to one's self, recover consciousness, revive.

प्रत्य्-आगत, अस्, आ, अम्, come back, come again,
returned; arrived at.

प्रत्य्-आगति, इस्, f. coming back, coming again,
return, coming home again.

प्रत्य्-आगम, अस्, m. coming back, coming again,
return; arrival.
—प्रत्यागमावधि (˚म-अव्˚),
ind. till (my) return.

प्रत्य्-आगमन, अम्, n. coming back, coming
again, return, coming home again.

प्रत्यागार प्रत्य्-आगार (?), अस्, m. former
place or state.

प्रत्यागॄ प्रत्य्-आ-गॄ (see rt. 1. गॄ), cl. 9. P.
A. -गृणाति, -गृणीते, -गरितुम्, -गरीतुम्, Ved.
to speak to in return, answer, respond.

प्रत्याघात प्रत्य्-आघात, अस्, m. (fr. प्रत्य्-
आ-हन्, q. v.), counter-stroke, reaction, repulse.

प्रत्याचक्ष् प्रत्य्-आ-चक्ष्, cl. 2. A. -चष्टे,
-चष्टुम्, to refuse, decline, reject; to repulse; to
answer.

प्रत्याचार प्रत्य्-आचार, अस्, m. suitable be-
haviour, conformable conduct.

प्रत्यातन् प्रत्य्-आ-तन्, cl. 8. P. A. -तनोति,
-तनुते, -तनितुम्, Ved. to extend in the direction
of (with acc.); to bend (a bow) against (with acc.);
to shine upon, irradiate.

प्रत्याताप प्रत्य्-आताप, अस्, m., Ved. a sunny
place.

प्रत्यात्म प्रत्य्-आत्म, अस्, आ, अम्, every single,
each several; (अम्), ind. singly, severally.
प्रत्यात्मक, अस्, इका, अम्, belonging to one's self.

प्रत्यात्म्य, अम्, n. similarity with or resem-
blance to one's self.

प्रत्यादर्श प्रत्य्-आदर्श, अस्, m. an image (?) ;
(perhaps only a wrong reading for प्रत्य्-आदेश, q. v.)

प्रत्यादा प्रत्य्-आ-दा, cl. 3. A. -दत्ते, -दातुम्,
to receive back, get back; to take back, recall, revoke,
rescind; to draw forth from; to repeat (Ved.).

प्रत्य्-आदित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. the Desid.), desirous of
retaking, intending to reobtain, wishing to obtain.

प्रत्य्-आदेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be received back;
to be received, to be accepted.

प्रत्यादित्य प्रत्य्-आदित्य, अस्, m. a mock sun,
parhelion; (at the beginning of a comp.) towards
the sun (e. g. प्रत्यादित्य-गुद, one whose hinder
parts are towards the sun).

प्रत्यादिश् प्रत्य्-आ-दिश्, cl. 6. P. -दिशति,
-देष्टुम्, to enjoin upon, direct, prescribe, advise,
recommend; to warn, caution; to report anything
to (with acc.), report again; to summon; to coun-
termand; to reject, repel, repulse, deny, dismiss; to
decline, refuse; to conquer, overcome.

प्रत्य्-आदिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, prescribed, recom-
mended; informed, apprised; declared; warned,
cautioned; rejected, repulsed; conquered, overcome;
removed, set aside.

प्रत्य्-आदेश, अस्, m. order, command; informa-
tion, apprising, informing, annunciation, declaration;
warning, caution, supernatural warning; rejection,
disallowance, refusal, denial; reproach; putting to
shame, any one who puts another to shame, the
shamer of another; obscuring, rendering obscure.

प्रत्य्-आदेष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, one who warns or
cautions.

प्रत्यादृ प्रत्य्-आ-दृ, cl. 6. A. -द्रियते, -दर्-
तुम्, Ved. to show respect to.

प्रत्याद्रु प्रत्य्-आ-द्रु, cl. 1. P. -द्रवति, -द्रो-
तुम्, to run against, rush upon, assail (with acc.).

प्रत्याधान प्रत्य्-आधान, अम्, n., Ved. a
place where anything is deposited or laid up, a
repository.

प्रत्याध्मान प्रत्य्-आध्मान, अम्, n. a parti-
cular nervous disease, a kind of tympanites or wind-
dropsy.

प्रत्यानह् प्रत्य्-आ-नह्, cl. 4. P. A. -नह्यति,
-ते, -नद्धुम्, to put upon, cover with.

प्रत्यानी प्रत्य्-आ-नी, cl. 1. P. A. -नयति, -ते,
[]
नेतुम्, to lead or bring back, regain; to pour
again (Ved.); to fill up again: Desid. A. -निनीषते,
to wish to bring back, try to rearrange.

प्रत्य्-आनयन, अम्, n. leading back, bringing
back again, giving back again, recovery.

प्रत्य्-आनिनीषु, उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of bringing
back.
प्रत्य्-आनीत, अस्, आ, अम्, led back, brought back.

प्रत्य्-आनेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be brought back; to
be repaired, to be made good.

प्रत्यापद् प्रत्य्-आ-पद्, cl. 4. A. -पद्यते,
-पत्तुम्, to go back, return back.
प्रत्य्-आपत्ति, इस्, f. return, going round again.
प्रत्य्-आपन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, restored, regained.

प्रत्यापीड प्रत्य्-आपीड, अस्, m. a kind of
metre.

प्रत्याप्लवन प्रत्य्-आप्लवन, अम्, n. springing
or leaping back.

प्रत्याब्रू प्रत्य्-आ-ब्रू, cl. 2. P. -ब्रवीति, &c.,
to reply to, answer.

प्रत्याभू प्रत्य्-आ-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भ-
वितुम्, Ved. to be at hand, be at one's command.

प्रत्याम्ना प्रत्य्-आ-म्ना, cl. 1. P. -मनति,
-म्नातुम्, Ved. to recite or repeat after any one.

प्रत्य्-आम्नातव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be rejected, to
be considered invalid or not binding.

प्रत्य्-आम्नान, अम्, n., Ved. contrary determina-
tion, altered purpose.

प्रत्य्-आम्नाय, अस्, m. contrary or altered deter-
mination; the conclusion or fifth member of a com-
plete syllogism, the repetition of the first member
(= नि-गमन).

प्रत्यारम्भ प्रत्य्-आरम्भ, अस्, m. beginning
again, recommencement, second beginning; prohi-
bition.

प्रत्यार्द्रा प्रत्य्-आर्द्रा, f., see Gaṇa Aṃśv-
ādi to Pāṇ. VI. 2, 193.

प्रत्यार्धपुर प्रत्य्-आर्धपुर, see Gaṇa Aṃśv-
ādi to Pāṇ. VI. 2, 193.

प्रत्यालिङ्ग् प्रत्य्-आ-लिङ्ग्, cl. 1. P. -लिङ्गति,
-लिङ्गितुम्, to embrace in return, return an embrace.

प्रत्यावृत् प्रत्य्-आ-वृत्, cl. 1. A. -वर्तते,
-वर्तितुम्, to come back, return.
प्रत्य्-आवर्तन, अम्, n. coming back, returning.
प्रत्य्-आवृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, come back, returned.

प्रत्य्-आवृत्य, ind. having come back, having
returned.

प्रत्याशा प्रत्य्-आशा, f. confidence, reliance,
trust, hope, expectation, desire.

प्रत्य्-आशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, hoping, expecting, trusting,
relying upon.

प्रत्याश्रय प्रत्य्-आश्रय, अस्, m. a shelter,
refuge, dwelling.

प्रत्याश्राव प्रत्य्-आश्राव, अस्, m. or प्रत्य्-
आश्रावण, अम्, n., Ved. an ejaculatory response,
a particular sacrificial formula.

प्रत्याश्वस् प्रत्य्-आ-श्वस्, cl. 2. P. -श्वसिति,
-श्वसितुम्, to breathe again, respire, take courage
again, take heart again.

प्रत्य्-आश्वस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, refreshed, revived,
reanimated; recollected.

प्रत्य्-आश्वास, अस्, m. breathing again, respiration,
recovery.
प्रत्य्-आश्वासन, अम्, n. consolation.

प्रत्यासङ्कलित प्रत्य्-आसङ्कलित, अस्, आ, अम्,
added to; ascertained, determined.

प्रत्यासङ्ग प्रत्य्-आसङ्ग, अस्, m., Ved. com-
bination, connection.

प्रत्यासद् प्रत्य्-आ-सद्, cl. 1. 6. P. -सीदति,
-सत्तुम्, to be near or close at hand.

प्रत्य्-आसत्ति, इस्, f. immediate proximity (in space,
time, &c.); close contact; analogy.

प्रत्य्-आसन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, near at hand, close by,
near, proximate, contiguous; imminent.
—प्रत्य्-
आसन्न-ता, f. proximity, contiguity.
—प्रत्यासन्न-
मृत्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, one whose death is imminent,
at the point of death.
प्रत्यासर प्रत्य्-आसर = प्रत्य्-आसार.

प्रत्यासार प्रत्य्-आसार, अस्, m. the rear of
an army; a form of array (?).

प्रत्यास्तार प्रत्य्-आस्तार, अस्, m. the carpet
of a Buddhist Bhikṣu.

प्रत्यास्वर प्रत्य्-आस्वर, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt.
स्वृ with प्रत्य्-आ), Ved. reflecting (light).

प्रत्याहन् प्रत्य्-आ-हन्, cl. 2. P. -हन्ति (Perf.
A. -जघ्ने), -हन्तुम्, to drive back, keep off,
ward off, parry.

प्रत्य्-आहत, अस्, आ, अम्, driven back, repelled,
repulsed, resisted.
प्रत्याहार प्रत्य्-आहार. See below.

प्रत्य्-आहार, अस्, m. drawing back (troops from
a battle), marching back, retreat; withholding; with-
drawing the senses from external objects, restraint of
the organs of sense, abstraction; the reabsorption or
dissolution of the world; (in grammar) the compre-
hension of a series of letters or affixes into one
syllable effected by combining the first member of
the series without its indicatory letter or letters with
the indicatory final consonant of the last member, a
group or class of letters so combined (for the concise
expression of grammatical rules; thus the Praty-
āhāra अच् is the technical term for the letters अ, इ, उ,
ऋ, ऌ, ए, ओ, ऐ, औ, or all the vowels, and the
Praty-āhāra हल् is the term for all the consonants);
compendium, abridgment; substitution (?).

प्रत्याहृ प्रत्य्-आ-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. -हरति,
-ते, -हर्तुम्, to take back again, draw back, with-
draw, recover; to utter (a speech); to cry; to report.

प्रत्य्-आहरण, अम्, n. bringing back; taking
back, recovery; drawing back, keeping back, with-
holding; withdrawing the senses from external ob-
jects, restraining the organs of sense.

प्रत्य्-आहरणीय or प्रत्य्-आहर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्,
to be taken back, resumable; to be withheld; to be
restrained or controlled.

प्रत्य्-आहरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, drawing back, with-
drawing; altering.

प्रत्य्-आहार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be taken back; to be
withheld or withdrawn; to be received; to be learned.

प्रत्य्-आहृत, अस्, आ, अम्, resumed; restrained;
withheld.

प्रत्य्-आहृत्य, ind. having drawn back, having
recovered or taken back.

प्रत्युक्त प्रत्य्-उक्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. प्रति-वच्),
said in return, replied, answered; (अम्), n. an answer.
प्रत्य्-उक्ति, इस्, f. a reply, answer, rejoinder.

प्रत्युच्चर् प्रत्य्-उच्-चर् (प्रति-उद्-चर्), Caus.
P. -चारयति, -यितुम्, to rouse up, excite, urge.

प्रत्य्-उच्चार, अस्, m. or प्रत्य्-उच्चारण, अम्,
n. repeating, repetition.

प्रत्य्-उच्चार्य, ind. having roused, having ex-
cited or urged.

प्रत्युज्जीव् प्रत्य्-उज्-जीव् (प्रति-उद्-जीव्), cl. 1.
P. -जीवति, -जीवितुम्, to return to life, revive: Caus.
-जीवयति, -यितुम्, to restore to life, revivify, resus-
citate, reanimate.

प्रत्य्-उज्जीवन, अम्, n. coming to life again,
reviving; restoring to life, revivifying.

प्रत्युत प्रत्य्-उत, ind. on the contrary,
rather, aye, even; on the other hand, otherwise.

प्रत्युत्कर्ष प्रत्य्-उत्कर्ष, अस्, m. enhancing,
overcharging raising prices.

प्रत्युत्क्रम प्रत्य्-उत्क्रम, अस्, m. or प्रत्य्-
उत्क्रमण, अम्, n. or प्रत्य्-उत्क्रान्ति, इस्, f. un-
dertaking; an act or effort made for a certain purpose
or tending to a main object; the first step or measure
in any business; setting out to assail an enemy;
declaration of war.

प्रत्युत्तब्धि प्रत्य्-उत्तब्धि, इस्, f. (fr. rt. स्तम्भ्
with प्रति-उद्), Ved. upholding, propping up, stay-
ing, supporting, fixing.
प्रत्य्-उत्तम्भ, अस्, m. = प्रत्य्-उत्तब्धि.

प्रत्युत्तर प्रत्य्-उत्तर, अम्, n. a reply to an
answer, rejoinder, answer.

प्रत्युत्तॄ प्रत्य्-उत्-तॄ (प्रति-उद्-तॄ), cl. 1. P.
-तरति, -तरितुम्, -तरीतुम्, to emerge (from the
water); to betake one's self to (with acc.).

प्रत्युत्था प्रत्य्-उत्-था (प्रति-उद्-स्था), cl. 1.
P. A. -तिष्ठति, -ते, -थातुम्, to rise up before,
rise to salute.

प्रत्य्-उत्थान, अम्, n. rising from a seat as a
mark of respect, rising to welcome a visitor, respectful
reception (Manu II. 210); making preparations for,
undertaking.
प्रत्य्-उत्थायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. rising again.

प्रत्य्-उत्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, risen to meet or to
encounter.

प्रत्य्-उत्थेय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be honoured
or saluted by rising from the seat.

प्रत्युत्पन्न प्रत्य्-उत्पन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, existing
at the present moment, present; prompt, ready; re-
produced, regenerated; (in arithmetic) produced by
multiplication, multiplied; (अम्), n. multiplication;
the product of a sum in multiplication.
—प्रत्युत्-
पन्न-जाति, इस्, f. (in arithmetic) assimilation of
fractional increase.
—प्रत्युत्पन्न-मति, इस्, इस्, इ,
ready-minded, having presence of mind or a prompt
understanding; quick, subtle, sharp; confident, bold,
arrogant.
—प्रत्युत्पन्नमति-त्व, अम्, n. presence
of mind.

प्रत्युदाहृ प्रत्य्-उद्-आ-हृ (प्रति-), cl. 1. P.
A. -हरति, -ते, -हर्तुम्, to speak in return, reply,
answer.

प्रत्य्-उदाहरण, अम्, n. a contrary example,
instance to the contrary, counter example or illustra-
tion; [cf. उद्-आहरण.]
प्रत्य्-उदाहृत, अस्, आ, अम्, called, named.

प्रत्युदीक्ष् प्रत्य्-उद्-ईक्ष् (प्रति-), cl. 1. A.
-ईक्षते, -ईक्षितुम्, to look up at, look at, perceive.

प्रत्युद्गम् प्रत्य्-उद्-गम्, cl. 1. P. (ep. also
A.) -गच्छति (-ते), -गन्तुम्, to go out towards,
advance towards, go forth against, go out to meet
(a friend or an enemy).

प्रत्य्-उद्गत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone out towards;
gone forth against; met; risen as from a seat.

प्रत्य्-उद्गति, इस्, f. or प्रत्य्-उद्गम, अस्, m.
or प्रत्य्-उद्गमन, अम्, n. going forth towards,
going out to meet (especially to meet a guest);
rising from a seat as a mark of respect.

प्रत्य्-उद्गमनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be met re-
spectfully; to be worshipped or reverenced; fit or
suitable for the respectful salutation of a guest; (अम्),
n. a clean suit of clothes or pair of garments, the
upper and lower garments as worn at meals, &c.

प्रत्युद्गा प्रत्य्-उद्-गा, cl. 3. P. -जिगाति, &c.,
Ved. to rise before or opposite to (as the sun).

प्रत्युद्गार प्रत्य्-उद्गार, अस्, m. a kind of
nervous disease.

प्रत्युद्गै प्रत्य्-उद्-गै, cl. 1. P. -गायति, -गा-
तुम्, Ved. to answer by singing, sing a response.

प्रत्युद्ग्रह् प्रत्य्-उद्-ग्रह्, cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्-
णाति, -गृह्णीते, -ग्रहीतुम्, Ved. to set aside, dismiss.

प्रत्युद्घात प्रत्य्-उद्घात, probably an error
for प्रत्य्-उद्यात, q. v.

प्रत्युद्धृ प्रत्य्-उद्-धृ (-उद्-हृ), cl. 1. P. -ह-
रति, -हर्तुम्, to raise or lift up again, extricate.

प्रत्य्-उद्धरण, अम्, n. raising up again; re-
covering, reobtaining.
प्रत्य्-उद्धृत, अस्, आ, अम्, recovered, reobtained.

प्रत्युद्यम प्रत्य्-उद्यम, अस्, m. counter-
balance, counterpoise, equipoise; (अस्, आ, अम्), coun-
terbalancing.

प्रत्य्-उद्यात, अस्, आ, अम्, met, saluted, welcomed,
received (as a guest); encountered.

प्रत्य्-उद्यातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, going forth against,
attacking, an assailant.

प्रत्युद्व्रज् प्रत्य्-उद्-व्रज्, cl. 1. P. -व्रजति,
-व्रजितुम्, to go towards, go out to meet.

प्रत्युन्नमन प्रत्य्-उन्नमन, अम्, n. rising
again, springing up again.

प्रत्युन्मिष् प्रत्य्-उन्-मिष् (प्रति-उद्-मिष्),
cl. 6. P. -मिषति, -मेषितुम्, ‘to open the eyes
upon,’ to rise or shine forth upon (as the sun); to
break forth.

प्रत्युपकृ प्रत्य्-उप-कृ, cl. 8. A. -कुरुते,
-कर्तुम्, to do a service in return, return a friendly
office, requite a favour; to repay.

प्रत्य्-उपकार, अस्, m. requital of aid or assist-
ance, mutual assistance; returning a service or favour,
return of a kindness, gratitude.

प्रत्य्-उपकारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, requiting a favour,
returning a kindness, grateful.

प्रत्य्-उपक्रिया, f. requital of a favour, return of
a service.

प्रत्युपगम् प्रत्य्-उप-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्-
छति, -गन्तुम्, to come near, approach, meet.

प्रत्य्-उपगत, अस्, आ, अम्, come near to, ap-
proached, met.

प्रत्युपदिश् प्रत्य्-उप-दिश्, cl. 6. P. -दिशति,
-देष्टुम्, to explain singly or severally; to teach
in return, advise or caution in return.

प्रत्य्-उपदिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, advised or cautioned
in return.

प्रत्य्-उपदेश, अस्, m. teaching or instructing in
return, advice or admonition in return.

प्रत्युपद्रु प्रत्य्-उप-द्रु, cl. 1. P. -द्रवति,
-द्रोतुम्, to rush against, fall upon, assail (with acc.).

प्रत्युपधा प्रत्य्-उप-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -द-
धाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, Ved. to put or place upon,
cover.

प्रत्युपाधा प्रत्य्-उपा-धा (प्रति-उप-आ-धा),
cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to attain
to again, regain, recover.

प्रत्युपपन्न प्रत्य्-उपपन्न, प्रत्युपपन्-
न-मति, = प्रत्य्-उत्पन्न, प्रत्युत्पन्न-मति,
q. q. v. v.

प्रत्युपभुज् प्रत्य्-उप-भुज्, cl. 7. A. -भुङ्क्ते,
-भोक्तुम्, to eat up, consume, eat.
प्रत्य्-उपभोग, अस्, m. enjoyment.

प्रत्युपमान प्रत्य्-उपमान, अम्, n. the coun-
terpart of a likeness or resemblance, copy, model,
pattern; a counter comparison.

प्रत्युपया प्रत्य्-उप-या, cl. 2. P. -याति, -या-
तुम्, to go again towards, return.

प्रत्युपलब्ध प्रत्य्-उपलब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, gained
back, regained.
—प्रत्युपलब्ध-चेतस्, आस्, आस्,
अस्, recovering the senses.

प्रत्युपविश् प्रत्य्-उप-विश्, cl. 6. P. -विशति,
-वेष्टुम्, to sit down opposite to.

प्रत्य्-उपवेश, अस्, m. or प्रत्य्-उपवेशन, अम्,
n. surrounding or besetting any one in order to
bring him to compliance.

प्रत्युपस्थान प्रत्य्-उपस्थान, अम्, n. prox-
imity, vicinity, neighbourhood.

प्रत्युपस्पर्शन प्रत्य्-उपस्पर्शन, अम्, n.,
Ved. rinsing or washing again.

प्रत्युपहव प्रत्य्-उपहव, अस्, m., Ved. a
response to an invitatory formula or the repetition
of an invitatory ejaculation.

प्रत्युपाकरण प्रत्य्-उपाकरण, अम्, n., Ved.
recommencing the reading (of the Veda), resumption
of study (?).

प्रत्युपे प्रत्य्-उपे (प्रति-उप-इ), cl. 2. P.
-उपैति, -उपैतुम्, Ved. to approach again.

प्रत्य्-उपेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be met; to be dealt
with or treated in turn, to be requited.

प्रत्युप्त प्रत्य्-उप्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. प्रति-वप्),
inserted, set, inlaid, studded; sown.

प्रत्युरस प्रत्य्-उरस, अम्, n. = प्रतिगतम्
उरः; (अम्), ind. against the breast, upon the breast.

प्रत्युलूक प्रत्य्-उलूक, अस्, m. a bird resem-
bling an owl; (according to a Scholiast) a hostile
owl, or a crow regarded as the enemy of the owl.
प्रत्युलूकक, अस्, m. a bird resembling an owl.

प्रत्युष् प्रत्य्-उष्, cl. 1. P. -ओषति, -ओषितुम्,
Ved. to singe, scorch.

प्रत्य्-उष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. burnt or consumed
one by one, (according to Mahī-dhara = प्रत्येकं
दग्ध.)

प्रत्य्-उष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be singed or
scorched.

प्रत्युष प्रत्य्-उष, अस्, m. or प्रत्य्-उषस्,
अस्, n. morning twilight, early morning, day-break,
dawn; the morning.

प्रत्य्-ऊष, अस्, अम्, m. n. morning twilight,
day-break, dawn, morning; (अस्), m. one of the
eight demigods called Vasus; the sun; N. of a man;
(आस्), m. pl., N. of his descendants.

प्रत्य्-ऊषस्, अस्, n. morning twilight, day-break,
dawn, morning.

प्रत्यूर्ध्वम् प्रत्य्-ऊर्ध्वम्, ind. on the upper
side of, above.

प्रत्यूह् प्रत्य्-ऊह्, cl. 1. P. A. -ऊहति, -ते,
-ऊहितुम्, to push back; to keep off, ward off; to
reject, refuse; to strip, strip off; to outstrip, surpass,
excel; to interrupt; to disturb; to offer up, present.
प्रत्य्-ऊह, अस्, m. an obstacle, impediment.

प्रत्य्-ऊहन, अम्, n., Ved. interruption; leaving
off, discontinuance.

प्रत्यृ प्रत्य्-ऋ, Caus. P. -अर्पयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to go towards, throw towards; to fasten,
fix, put on; to cause to go back, render up, deliver
back, give back, restore, return; to give again.

प्रत्य्-अर्पणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be given back,
to be returned or restored, to be delivered back.

प्रत्य्-अर्पित, अस्, आ, अम्, fastened, fixed, put on;
delivered back, restored, returned.
प्रत्य्-ऋत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. inserted.

प्रत्यृचम् प्रत्य्-ऋचम्, ind., Ved. at each
verse, in each verse.

प्रत्ये प्रत्य्-ए (प्रति-आ-इ), cl. 2. P. -ऐति,
-ऐतुम्, to come back, return to (with acc.).

प्रत्य्-एत्य, ind. having come back, having re-
turned.

प्रत्येक प्रत्य्-एक, अस्, आ, अम्, each one, each
single one, every one; (अम्), ind. one by one, one
at a time, singly, severally; for every single one.
—प्रत्येक-बुद्ध, अस्, m. a Buddha who lives
in seclusion and obtains emancipation for himself
only (as opposed to those Buddhas who liberate
others also).
—प्रत्येकबुद्ध-त्व, अम्, n. the
state of a Pratyeka Buddha.
—प्रत्येक-शस्, ind.
one by one, singly, severally.

प्रत्येनस् प्रत्य्-एनस्, आस्, m., Ved. an officer
of justice, punisher of criminals; a surety, the heir
nearest of kin who is responsible for the debts of a
deceased person.

प्रात्यग्रथि प्रात्यग्रथि, इस्, m. a patro-
nymic from Pratyag-ratha.

प्रात्यन्तिक प्रात्यन्तिक, अस्, m. (fr. प्रत्य्-
अन्त), a prince of the Pratyantas; a lord of the
marches, keeper of the borders (?).

प्रात्यवेक्षा प्रात्यवेक्षा, wrongly for प्रत्य्-
अवेक्षा, q. v.

प्रात्यहिक प्रात्यहिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रत्य्-
अहम्), occurring or happening every day, daily.

प्रत्यय-लोप, अस्, m. elision of a grammatical
affix or suffix.

प्रत्यय-स्वर, अस्, m. ‘suffix accent,’ an accent
on a suffix or affix.
प्रत्य्-आवृत्ति, इस्, f. turning back, return.
प्रत्य्-आह्वय, अस्, m. ‘calling in reply,’ an echo.
